verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a beta Agent Management API that can create, discover, update and delete Agents, manage Agent files and Skills, and authenticate machine clients via OIDC. A probe also found an OpenAPI document on the site, so some programmatic surface exists. That API is beta and covers only agents; the evidence never claims parity with the UI, and many UI features (conversations, MCP settings, admin config, memory, search) have no documented API. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of chat/conversations and other UI features, explicit UI–API parity claim, non-beta stability, independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
